owner.name: Rekha Lohan
owner.background: Founder of The Performance College. Extensive experience as a trainer and assessor in the childcare and leadership sectors. Operates a Registered Training Organisation (RTO 46069) and CRICOS-registered provider (CRICOS 04180C) delivering nationally recognised AQF vocational qualifications to domestic and international students from a Melbourne CBD campus.
owner.why_started: Believed vocational education could genuinely put students first — too many providers focus on compliance and enrolment numbers over an engaging learning experience that prepares students for real careers. Also saw the unique challenges international students face (new culture, support networks, unfamiliar education system) and wanted a college that delivers quality education while genuinely caring about each student's success and wellbeing. Vision: high-quality, industry-relevant training in a welcoming, inclusive, multicultural environment with innovation, flexibility and personalised support.

client_keyword_priorities.note: The client's 31 stated preferences concentrate ENTIRELY on Early Childhood Education (21 across Cert III + Diploma) and Individual Support / aged & disability care (10). NO preferences were given for Construction, Cabinet Making, Leadership/Management, Community Services, First Aid or Child Protection — signalling that Early Childhood + Individual Support are the SEO priority verticals. With only 5 general slots against 8 verticals, general keywords should anchor on these two priority verticals (top course heads); the remaining verticals are covered via location-qualified variants across the suburb grid. Many preferences are already location-qualified ('... Melbourne'), aligning naturally with the 60-location package.

locations.note: suburb_source = client-provided (honours the deliberate Q15 list). Phase 2 validates + enriches with search volume. ideal_customer: Two groups. (1) DOMESTIC — Australian residents (or visa holders with study rights, excluding student visa 500) seeking nationally recognised VET qualifications in individual support (ageing/disability) and early childhood education & care; want flexible online + live Zoom delivery to launch or advance careers. (2) INTERNATIONAL — aspiring professionals worldwide wanting CRICOS-registered qualifications, studying on-campus in Melbourne CBD across individual support, community services, early childhood, trade, business and management. Both groups are career-focused, want practical industry-relevant education with strong support services, and aim to enter the Australian workforce quickly in high-opportunity industries.
mission: To help aspiring professionals achieve meaningful careers through quality vocational education, industry placements, and dedicated student support.
values: Industry connection — preparing students for real careers, not just qualifications
Student success — students at the centre of every decision
community: Believes its role extends beyond delivering qualifications. As many students are international students and new migrants, regularly organises student social events, orientation activities, cultural celebrations and graduation ceremonies to foster friendships, inclusion and belonging. Provides guidance on living, studying and working in Australia, and is growing its industry and community partnerships to create more student opportunities.

bdm_brief.summary: A lot of new services since the last engagement — need to discover all of them. Previously targeted only the immigrant/international community; now open to all Australians (domestic students added). Was a Supple client for a short time before.
bdm_brief.strategic_implication: Audience pivot from international-only to international + domestic. Domestic delivery is flexible online + live Zoom (Cert III / Diploma Early Childhood & Individual Support), which broadens the domestic-search opportunity beyond on-campus international students. Content and keyword targeting should serve BOTH audiences (e.g. 'childcare course Melbourne' domestic online + 'childcare course for international students Melbourne' CRICOS).
